C1831.title: Putuo District Procuratorate Closes "Proxy Recharge" Case, Recovering Over 100 Million Yuan in Losses; Defendant Sentenced to Eight Years
C1831.summary: In April 2025, the Putuo District People's Procuratorate of Shanghai reported its comprehensive cyber-prosecution work, disclosing that from 2021 to 2024 it had reviewed and prosecuted 1,098 cybercrime cases involving 1,806 suspects. Among them, it closed a "proxy recharge" case in which the defendant bypassed official recharge channels to offer low-priced recharge services for profit and was sentenced to eight years' imprisonment, with losses exceeding 100 million yuan fully recovered through coordinated efforts. The case is a typical example of combating chained, technology-driven cyber black-market crime.
